contract: Actionable alt-data axis for the Mastermind bot. Each signal: signal_score 0-100 (composite of weighted convergence + brain conviction + price confirm − extension), action ∈ {ACCUMULATE,WATCH,AVOID}, direction ∈ {long,short,neutral}, source ∈ {brain,deterministic}. The bot sizes through its OWN risk framework; this is an input, not an order. Brain calls are graded vs SPY (see calibration). An extended name is never ACCUMULATE. trump_linked / affiliations flag actor ties. rolling_over names (off_high≤−15% AND 20d<0 AND below 50dma) appear in broken_signals only — crowd attention, NOT entries. entry_tier (T1/T2/T3) = validated confluence buy gate signal.
regime_read: The strongest measured alignment is concentrated in semiconductors, enterprise AI, and selected idiosyncratic situations, but several signals rely partly on sentiment or affiliations rather than confirmed capital flows. With no completed track record, conviction remains modest and near-extended PLTR is a watch rather than a chase.

calibration.note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.

signals.thesis: MSFT's alignment spans end-user demand, developer activity, model-download momentum, and a broad patent cluster [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]. The factual Sam Altman partnership connects that activity to the enterprise-AI distribution channel [actor:Sam Altman], while the disclosed Bill Ackman affiliation is supportive but qualitative [actor:Bill Ackman].
second_order: NVDA — expanding enterprise-AI workloads can increase accelerator demand
Data-center infrastructure — cloud and model usage require additional compute, networking, and power capacity

falsifier.text: Developer and model-download momentum decelerates without corresponding improvement in enterprise AI demand.

signals.thesis: PLTR has the broadest channel count, led by accelerating government contracts and a fully bullish analyst cluster, with retail and Stocktwits sentiment reinforcing attention [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]. However, the Trump-linked signal is explicitly on the sell side and the stock is only narrowly below the desk's extended threshold, so the convergence does not justify chasing [trump]. Cathie Wood's disclosed affiliation and Marjorie Taylor Greene's disclosed stake are secondary context [actor:Cathie Wood] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene].
second_order: MSFT — broader government and enterprise AI adoption can support cloud-compute demand
Government AI software — contract acceleration may indicate wider agency adoption of operational analytics

falsifier.text: Government-contract acceleration reverses or relative strength moves above the extended threshold without a reset.

signals.thesis: MU has the clearest non-extended alignment: net congressional buying by multiple members, strongly positive insider purchase activity, a large patent cluster, and bullish community sentiment all point in the same direction [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]. Its recent relative underperformance leaves a more favorable entry than the crowded AI leaders, while the disclosed Ro Khanna affiliation adds context but is not treated as a stand-alone signal [actor:Ro Khanna].
second_order: AMAT — memory-capacity investment would support semiconductor-equipment demand
Semiconductor manufacturing equipment — higher memory investment can propagate upstream to fabrication tools

falsifier.text: Congressional and insider buying reverses while patent activity fails to translate into improving memory investment.

disclaimer: An AI reading of the desk's own deterministic convergence — accountable and checkable, not a guarantee. Every call cites the channels/actors it is based on, is graded vs SPY over the horizon, and can be wrong or overconfident. The Mastermind sizes it through its own risk framework; treat as odds, not a forecast.
